subject: general
question: The Mana Ooru - Mana Badi programme was formally launched by the ___________ government in March 2022 to introduce English medium in government schools.
solution:
The correct answer is Telangana. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Mana Ooru - Mana Badi programme** was launched by the **Telangana government** in **March 2022.**
 
• The aim of the programme is to introduce **English medium **in government schools in** Telangana.**
 
• The programme is designed to provide **quality education **to children in** government schools** and make them competitive in the **global job market.**
 
• The programme is expected to benefit around **10 lakh students** studying in over** 25,000 government schools **in Telangana.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Odisha:**

 
 
• The Odisha government launched the '**Sikshya Setu' programme in 2021** to provide** online education** to students during the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
 
 
• **West Bengal:**
 
 
• The West Bengal government launched the **'Duare Duare Paschim Banga Sarkar'** campaign in** 2021** to provide **doorstep delivery **of **government services** to the people of the state.
 
 
 
• **Andhra Pradesh:**
 
 
• The Andhra Pradesh government launched the** 'Amma Vodi' scheme** in **2020 **to provide financial assistance to mothers who send their **children to school.**
